title: Paragraph marks, a forced line break and a style run
concept:
Three paragraphs in two ParagraphStyleRanges:
ends a paragraph, a U+2028 forced line break does not, and a new range starts only where paragraph attributes change.

annotations.note: The first ParagraphStyleRange: a style run holding two paragraphs that share the same paragraph attributes.
is the paragraph mark: the first paragraph ends here.
is a forced line break (U+2028). The line breaks, but the paragraph goes on: no new indent, no space before.

This
ends the second paragraph. It belongs to the range before the attribute change.
The third paragraph has its own SpaceBefore, so it starts a new ParagraphStyleRange. As the story's last paragraph it ends without a mark.
